selected_evidence.summary: inventorysvc user created (no prior existence confirmed), unit file installed, service enabled+started, and ps/systemctl show confirm the process runs as inventorysvc, not root.
Captured baseline boot_id (513c865e-e121-4025-a0a4-8689cc580398) and confirmed inventory-worker.service was active and enabled before restart.
Issued 'sudo shutdown -r now' backgrounded; acknowledgement returned before the node disconnected.

commands.command:
cat <<'ANTRIEB_EOF' | sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service
[Unit]
Description=Inventory Worker (os-comparison-worker)
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=inventorysvc
Group=inventorysvc
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker
Restart=on-failure
NoNewPrivileges=yes
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=yes

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
ANTRIEB_EOF
sudo systemctl daemon-reload
